verdict.rationale: The pack documents no rule engine or no-code automation feature for defining event-triggered actions. Shopify webhooks only deliver event data to an app, so the developer must write the code that performs the action. That makes webhooks a developer building block, not a rules-to-actions capability, and they earn no credit here. Automated tax filing is an unrelated, fixed automation, not user-defined rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
